[p0001] CHAPTER 2 THE STORM
[p0002] Captain Ilse Varga had been promoted after the spring inspection.
[p0003] When the storm wrecked the harbor, Ilse and the Grey Fox became allies.
[p0004] The Grey Fox pulled back his hood, and Ilse saw that he was Petr Lask.
[p0005] Years ago, Ilse and Petr had been childhood rivals in Greyford.
[p0006] The engineer Mara Quill repaired the signal lamp with Ilse.
[p0007] Mara said the old harbor master might be paying the smugglers.
[p0008] The Harbor Watch now worked alongside the Grey Fox to save the town.
